description: This file defines an interface for retrieving product images within a CMS system, specifying methods for accessing images by various parameters such as product code, image name, size, and ProductImage object, as well as retrieving all images for a product.

classes.name: ProductImageGet
classes.description: An interface extending ImageGet, providing methods to retrieve product images and related data.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image based on merchant store code, product code, and image name.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image with specified size.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image based on a ProductImage object.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a given Product.
